newsitem.title: INDIA: India sees at least 7 pct GDP growth in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India sees at least 7 pct GDP growth in 97/98.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that the government expects gross domestic product (GDP) to grow by at least seven percent in 1997/98 (April-March), and aims for an eight percent rise.
Chidambaram was asked how much the government's 1997/98 (April-March) budget would boost growth in the current fiscal year.
"We would like to have at least seven percent growth and aim at eight percent," he told reporters after the lower house of parliament approved the 1997/98 Finance Bill.
